head: roam sets alarms that ring only when you're in that time zone
dek: In roam, each alarm belongs to a time zone and rings only while your phone is there, so travel alarms switch on when you land and home alarms take over when you're back. It was #63 among paid Utilities apps on the US App Store on 10 November.
details: The sound starts quietly and builds over 16 seconds, never past half volume. There's no account and nothing is collected. It costs $14.99 with no in-app purchases, by Blake Ziolkowski, and needs iOS 26.
means: Frequent travelers won't get a 3 a.m. alarm set for a city they already left.
todo: Find roam in the App Store.
thumb_words: ALARMS THAT KNOW WHERE YOU ARE
